head: Inyo Notes saves everything you write to its day
dek: Inyo is a notes app organized by day: it opens ready to write, and each entry with text, photos, links and tags is saved to its day. It was #61 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It came out on 6 November and costs $9.99, by Jason Bartholomew Stavers.
means: If you like a journal-style notes app, everything stays in date order.
todo: Find Inyo Notes in the App Store.
